SELECT pp.point_provider_id AS pointProviderId, pp.point_provider_name AS providerName, pp.point_provider_type AS providerType, pp.logo_image_url AS logoImageUrl, CASE WHEN mr.membership_register_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isRegistered, pp.default_recommend_yn AS defaultRecommendYn, pp.recommend_priority AS recommendPriority, pp.recommend_message AS recommendMessage,
(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t.place_name ORDER BY t.point_usage_place_id SEPARATOR ',') FROM (SELECT pup.point_usage_place_id, pup.place_name FROM point_usage_place pup WHERE pup.point_provider_id = pp.point_provider_id AND pup.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY pup.point_usage_place_id LIMIT 3) t) AS mainUsePlaces FROM point_provider pp LEFT JOIN membership_register mr ON pp.point_provider_id = mr.point_provider_id AND mr.member_id = #{memberId} AND mr.register_status = 'REGISTERED' WHERE pp.point_provider_type = 'MEMBERSHIP' AND pp.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY pp.default_recommend_yn DESC, pp.recommend_priority ASC, pp.point_provider_name ASC
SELECT point_provider_id AS pointProviderId, point_provider_name AS providerName, point_provider_type AS providerType, use_yn AS useYn FROM point_provider WHERE point_provider_id = #{pointProviderId}

SELECT mr.membership_register_id AS membershipRegisterId, mr.point_provider_id AS pointProviderId, pp.point_provider_name AS providerName, mr.register_status AS registerStatus, DATE_FORMAT(mr.registered_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS registeredAt FROM membership_register mr JOIN point_provider pp ON mr.point_provider_id = pp.point_provider_id WHERE mr.member_id = #{memberId} AND mr.point_provider_id = #{pointProviderId} AND mr.register_status = 'REGISTERED' LIMIT 1

SELECT mr.membership_register_id AS membershipRegisterId, mr.point_provider_id AS pointProviderId, pp.point_provider_name AS providerName, mr.register_status AS registerStatus, DATE_FORMAT(mr.registered_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS registeredAt FROM membership_register mr JOIN point_provider pp ON mr.point_provider_id = pp.point_provider_id WHERE mr.member_id = #{memberId} AND mr.point_provider_id = #{pointProviderId} AND mr.register_status = 'CANCELED' ORDER BY mr.canceled_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO membership_register ( member_id, point_provider_id, register_status, registered_at, canceled_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{pointProviderId}, 'REGISTERED', NOW(), NULL )
mapper.update: UPDATE membership_register SET register_status = 'REGISTERED', registered_at = NOW(), canceled_at = NULL WHERE membership_register_id = #{membershipRegisterId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO point_wallet ( member_id, point_provider_id, total_point, updated_at ) SELECT #{memberId}, #{pointProviderId}, 0, NOW() WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM point_wallet WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND point_provider_id = #{pointProviderId} )

SELECT mr.membership_register_id AS membershipRegisterId, mr.point_provider_id AS pointProviderId, pp.point_provider_name AS providerName, mr.register_status AS registerStatus, DATE_FORMAT(mr.registered_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS registeredAt FROM membership_register mr JOIN point_provider pp ON mr.point_provider_id = pp.point_provider_id WHERE mr.member_id = #{memberId} AND mr.membership_register_id = #{membershipRegisterId}

mapper.select: SELECT membership_register_id AS membershipRegisterId, register_status AS registerStatus, DATE_FORMAT(canceled_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS canceledAt FROM membership_register WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND membership_register_id = #{membershipRegisterId}

SELECT mr.membership_register_id AS membershipRegisterId, mr.point_provider_id AS pointProviderId, pp.point_provider_name AS providerName, pp.logo_image_url AS logoImage, pp.official_site_url AS officialSiteUrl, mr.register_status AS registerStatus, COALESCE(pw.total_point, 0) AS totalPoint, DATE_FORMAT(mr.registered_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS registeredAt, pp.recommend_message AS recommendMessage,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM expense e JOIN point_usage_place pup ON pup.place_name = e.merchant_name WHERE e.member_id = mr.member_id AND pup.point_provider_id = mr.point_provider_id AND pup.use_yn = 'Y' AND e.payment_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)) AS recentUseCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) FROM expense e JOIN point_usage_place pup ON pup.place_name = e.merchant_name WHERE e.member_id = mr.member_id AND pup.point_provider_id = mr.point_provider_id AND pup.use_yn = 'Y' AND e.payment_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)) AS recentUseAmount FROM membership_register mr JOIN point_provider pp ON mr.point_provider_id = pp.point_provider_id LEFT JOIN point_wallet pw ON mr.member_id = pw.member_id AND mr.point_provider_id = pw.point_provider_id WHERE mr.member_id = #{memberId} AND mr.membership_register_id = #{membershipRegisterId}

SELECT pup.point_usage_place_id AS usagePlaceId, pup.place_name AS placeName, c.category_name AS categoryName, pup.use_yn AS useYn, pup.description AS description FROM point_usage_place pup LEFT JOIN category c ON pup.category_id = c.category_id WHERE pup.point_provider_id = #{pointProviderId} AND pup.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY pup.point_usage_place_id ASC

SELECT mr.membership_register_id AS membershipRegisterId, pp.point_provider_id AS pointProviderId, pp.point_provider_name AS providerName, pp.official_site_url AS officialSiteUrl, pp.point_provider_type AS providerType, pp.logo_image_url AS logoImageUrl, COALESCE(pw.total_point, 0) AS totalPoint, DATE_FORMAT(mr.registered_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS registeredAt FROM membership_register mr JOIN point_provider pp ON mr.point_provider_id = pp.point_provider_id LEFT JOIN point_wallet pw ON mr.member_id = pw.member_id AND mr.point_provider_id = pw.point_provider_id WHERE mr.member_id = #{memberId} AND mr.register_status = 'REGISTERED' AND pp.point_provider_type = 'MEMBERSHIP' AND pp.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY mr.registered_at DESC
